text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road takes 1st, it's Narita Top 
Road!! She gloriously seizes the crown of 
Derby Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UWAAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ngggh, alright...!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haaah--

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Wah... wait, Ayabe-san...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, no! —Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I guess this is your first time?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...You looked right at me with such a 
direct gaze, looking so genuinely 
frustrated for my sake."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...Now I'm certain. Ayabe-san will 
definitely become even stronger by the 
time the Kikuka Sho comes around.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"So, I have no intention of slacking off 
either! I'll reforge myself at the summer 
training camp. Going all out, focusing on 
stamina!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: And so— Let's race again, Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Next time, at the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: At the Kikuka Sho... once more.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Haa, ngh...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (My legs are wobbling. ...I'm exhausted.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, my body feels strangely light. 
Just floating, like a balloon with its 
string cut—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(I feel like I might just start running 
again.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Next is the final race of the Classic 
Triple Crown line... the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Next time, too... a race like today's—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.
